issue.title: Improved documentation and error handling

repository.name: playframework
repository.description: The Community Maintained High Velocity Web Framework For Java and Scala.

issue.body:
This ensures that things like setting null headers as reported in #1403 are
easier to debug.

body:
As a first step for this, I've changed logging of all exceptions to be done at error.

I think we should still send a 500 error, rather than send an empty response, but this should help at least debug the issue.
Nice job, @jroper. Next time I hope Play throws an exception when null value is passed to setHeader method even if the value must not be null.

issue.title: Handle null response headers

repository.name: playframework
repository.description: The Community Maintained High Velocity Web Framework For Java and Scala.

issue.body:
This is actually a follow-up fix to #1403.

By throwing the exception up front, it makes it easier to determine where the null header is inserted, and also makes it possible for filters to detect this type of error.
